description: Part channels sampled from a clip, held to the same rules as joint channels. Sampled at t = 0.62, inside a segment whose earlier key uses smoothstep, so the part and the joint channels must bracket the same pair of keys and ease by the same u -- a part and a joint keyed on the same clip drifting apart in TIME is the failure this case exists to catch, and it is invisible in a pose-only fixture. Three sparsity traps are set: 'lid' sets scale only at t = 0.35 and never again, so scale must decay toward 1 rather than hold 1.25; 'lid' sets rot only at t = 0.9, so rot must rise from 0 rather than from wherever it was; and 'body' is mentioned by no part key at all, so its transform must come out as exactly the identity. The clip loops, so the joint half also re-covers the synthetic wrap key -- which now has to carry key 0's PARTS as well as its joints.
